summary: R26.2 customer-facing ASAP vehicle picker certification. Backend: /api/asap/vehicles catalog + 7 per-vehicle smoke quotes + LWB Van canonical + Recovery canonical + vehicle_too_small + international guardrail = 12/12 pytest tests PASSED. Frontend E2E: LWB Van (£70/£10.50@15%/£80.50) and Recovery (£110/£16.50@15%/£126.50) both drove correct quote body, correct summary panel, correct submit-button label, /api/jobs 200 → /api/bookings 200 → /deposit 200 → Stripe redirect with the exact £ deposit shown on the Stripe page. Vehicle-too-small correctly hides the price summary and shows an error containing 'too small', 'recommend', 'Car', and '7.5T Rigid'. Articulated HGV → £400/£52@13%/£452 with resolved_vehicle_key='articulated_hgv'. Auto-recommend (empty picker) → car @ £39/£5.85 (see note). STOPPED before entering the Stripe test card as instructed.

ui_bugs.issue: AsapRequest.jsx passes `data-testid="asap-pickup"` and `data-testid="asap-dropoff"` to <AddressAutocomplete/> but the component's prop is `testID`, not `data-testid`. As a result the pickup/dropoff-scoped test ids (asap-pickup, asap-pickup-open, asap-pickup-modal, asap-dropoff, asap-dropoff-open, asap-dropoff-modal) never render — both fall back to the generic `address-open` / `address-modal`, making pickup vs dropoff undistinguishable in tests and breaking the picker's stated data-testid contract. Fix: rename the prop to `testID` at the call sites (AsapRequest.jsx L503 and L524) or accept `data-testid` inside AddressAutocomplete.

When the pricing engine returns a 422 with `detail={code, message}` (e.g. vehicle_too_small), the frontend surfaces the raw serialised object string in the red banner — the user sees the literal JSON '{"code":"vehicle_too_small","message":"Car is too small for your load…"}' instead of just the human message. Assertion still passes because the substrings 'too small'/'recommend'/'Car'/'7.5T Rigid' are present, but the banner is ugly. Fix: in the /asap/quote catch on L283-286 of AsapRequest.jsx, try JSON.parse(raw) and prefer parsed.message when available (same treatment onSubmit already does for high-level errors).

action_items: (Optional/LOW) In AsapRequest.jsx swap `data-testid` → `testID` on the two <AddressAutocomplete/> instances so the picker-scoped testids advertised for automation actually render.
